dossier.scp_unleashed.087.title: The Stairwell
dossier.scp_unleashed.087.caption: SCP-087 from its top landing, looking down the first flight.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The housing of SCP-087 cannot be moved, damaged or sealed. Its steel door is to be kept shut and watched from a distance.
**Descent is permitted only for approved exploration teams.** Teams are to carry their own light and are to turn back the moment they lose sight of one another.
No item is to be left inside SCP-087. %rNothing left behind has ever been recovered.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-087 is a plain concrete stairwell behind an unmarked steel door, inside a small concrete housing. Each flight has thirteen steps and ends at a half-landing, where the stairs turn back on themselves. A steel handrail runs along both walls. There is no light source of any kind.
The stairs descend further than any team has followed them. Teams report that the dark grows heavier the deeper they go, until a lamp shows only a few steps ahead.
SCP-087-2 is a pale face with dark, empty eyes and a slightly open mouth. It is seen below, on a stair or a landing, watching. It has never been reached. %rDeeper teams report it closer.%r
SCP-087-3 has been met only by the deepest teams. Survivors describe a tall, thin figure that moves very fast in the dark.

page.title: Addendum 087-1: Exploration I
text: A D-Class subject descended with a lamp and a radio. Somewhere past the tenth flight he reported a face on the landing below him. He walked towards it for some time but never drew level with it.
On the climb back he asked twice who was laughing.

page.title: Addendum 087-2: Exploration III
text: The team lost radio contact well past the thirtieth flight. The last recording holds slow, heavy footsteps on the stairs and a long low hiss. %rOne member returned.%r
Every team that has come back up found the door exactly as they left it.

message.scp_unleashed.scp087.outside: You are standing outside the stairwell door.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.inert: You stumble back out through the steel door. Behind it, the stairwell is silent.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.rule.break: The concrete does not even scratch.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.rule.build: There is nowhere to put that.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.rule.item: Not here. Not in this dark.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.rule.escape: There is only up or down.
message.scp_unleashed.scp087.rule.toss: You keep a tight grip on it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp087.0: Stair housing reported in open country.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp087.away: Return to the overworld to trace it.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp087.inert: The stairwell now ends after four flights.
Nothing has been seen below since.
archive.scp_unleashed.lead.scp087_traced: A survey has traced a stair housing nearby.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.place.over: The SCP-087 entrance can only be placed in the Overworld.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.place.aim: Look at the ground where the entrance should stand.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.place.succ: Placed the SCP-087 entrance; its door is at %s, %s, %s.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.not_inside: You must be descending SCP-087 to do that.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.depth: Your party is now %s flights down.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.no_room: There was no free stair or landing in range.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp087.status: SCP-087: %s, %s, %s open stairwell(s), you are %s flights down.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp087_door.outside: Cold air seeps from under it.
jade.scp_unleashed.scp087_door.sealed: It has no lock and no sign.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp087_door.1: A heavy, unmarked steel door. Doors like this one open onto the SCP-087 stairwell.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp087_door.2: Nothing can be built, broken or poured inside the stairwell. Only what you carry in your hands comes with you.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp087_concrete.1: Plain concrete from the SCP-087 stairwell. No tool, blast or flood has ever marked it.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp087_stairs.1: Concrete steps, thirteen to a flight. Nobody has counted how many flights there are.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp087_rail.1: A cold steel handrail. In the dark it is the only guide down.
SCP-087-3 is a tall, thin figure that lives deep in the stairwell. It is very hard to see; its eyes give it away first.
It hunts players and D-Class alike, and it can cross a landing in a single leap.
It has %s health. Wounds close if it is left alone for long.
arrival.scp_unleashed.scp087_stairwell.s: It goes further down than it should
